summary: Brookfield Infrastructure filed a 6-K attaching a November 5, 2026 press release confirming all required approvals to complete its previously announced Simplification, collapsing Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation into a single entity, BIP Inc. (the non-US equivalent of a holdco reorganization/share exchange). Expected closing is November 19, 2026, with holders receiving BIP Inc. Class A shares one-for-one; Class A shares trade on NYSE/TSX as 'BIP' from about November 23. No Q4 distribution is declared pending closing; a US$0.455 quarterly dividend is intended afterward. The DRIP terminates effective November 5. Watch re-enrollment deadlines and index/ticker migration risk.
